joinAMeetingToSeeItHere: Join a meeting and updates will appear here after completion
transcriptDescription: This meeting doesn't have a transcript. Transcripts are available when meeting recording is enabled.

meetingNotStartedDescription: Duration and other meeting details will be available after the meeting starts.

confirmDocumentUpdate: Accept changes. Creates/updates your document. Structure may change, but data remains. You can revert this change at any time. Application may take up to a minute.
